description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and structures related to message storage and metadata within the WPEFramework Core Messaging namespace. It includes definitions for events, message metadata, control interfaces, and various message info classes used for logging, tracing, and reporting.

classes.name: IEvent
classes.description: Interface for event objects with serialization capabilities and data access.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Class representing metadata associated with messages, including type, category, and module.

classes.name: IControl
classes.description: Interface for control objects with enable, destroy, and metadata retrieval functions.

classes.name: MessageInfo
classes.description: Class extending Metadata to include timestamp information for messages.

classes.name: IStore
classes.description: Interface for message storage mechanisms, supporting push and default checks.

classes.name: Logging
classes.description: Derived class from MessageInfo for logging messages.

classes.name: Tracing
classes.description: Derived class from MessageInfo for tracing messages, including file, line, and class info.

classes.name: WarningReporting
classes.description: Derived class from MessageInfo for warning reports, including callsign info.

methods.name: Metadata::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes Metadata object into a buffer.

methods.name: Metadata::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes buffer into a Metadata object.

methods.name: MessageInfo::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes MessageInfo object into a buffer.

methods.name: MessageInfo::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes buffer into a MessageInfo object.

methods.name: MessageInfo::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MessageInfo object.

methods.name: Tracing::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes Tracing object into a buffer.

methods.name: Tracing::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes buffer into a Tracing object.

methods.name: Tracing::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Tracing object.

methods.name: WarningReporting::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes WarningReporting object into a buffer.

methods.name: WarningReporting::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes buffer into a WarningReporting object.

methods.name: WarningReporting::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the WarningReporting object.
